verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench is a public, plain-language knowledge base with build guides on Form, Finance, Operate, Hire, Partner, and Protect, plus free tools (Document Driver, Capital Calculator, Liquidation Calculator) and explainers on SAFEs, entity formation, and equity dilution. missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of content quality and evidence of FAQ-style or deeper explainer breadth beyond the core build guides and tool pages.
